_comment: The ONE place for e2e hosts, slugs and backend URLs. e2e/scripts/e2e-env.py resolves it with the run's choices (E2E_<SLOT>, E2E_EXPECT_*, E2E_LINK_TYPES) for e2e/scripts/e2e-maestro.sh and .github/workflows/e2e.yml. Nothing else may hardcode a host, slug or backend URL. The published SDK always talks to its built-in production backend, so the only environment is prod and 'override_backend' stays false. 'host' in links names the environment field the slug is served on; an override must use that same host. 'link_types': one dedicated link per link type and environment ({host, slug}, deep link /products/aj1, customData linkType/source); a type with no entry for the run's environment is skipped with a notice (e.g. 'event': its per_event link does not exist on prod). E2E_LINK_TYPES picks them (all, none, or a comma list). 'link_type_expect': what the link-type allow runs must show (product, voucher, and customData source next to linkType == the type). 'backend_checks': which verify-endpoint checks this environment's backend serves (earning = reward/earning on the click; device_lookup = lookup by SDK device id for the probabilistic flows, which needs the SDK's debug-only device id and so stays false for the published binary; reengagement_open_count = openCount counting a re-engagement open; events = the click's events/revenue after the reward-events flows). A false check is recorded as skipped, never pass or fail; a true one is required. 'link_type_rewards': the reward model each type's link must carry (null = no reward); the backend check reads the amount from the response, never from here. 'link_type_kinds': the real backend link type (general, campaign, influencer, partner) each matrix type's link has; event and revshare are pseudo-types. A per_event / rev_share type runs only on the flows that send events (e2e-flows.json link_type_matrix lists it); 'link_type_matrix: true' means every type whose reward is null or per_install. 'reward_events': what those flows send after the counted install (rev_share: one revenue_event worth revenue_minor in the reward's currency, plus the same in the first of other_currencies that differs, which must add nothing; a no-reward type (general) sends revenue_event twice + other_event once: counted as events, earning 0).
